verdict.rationale: Neon's open-source repository says the platform can be compiled and run on a workstation, so the same engine can run locally without a Neon account. The docs scope it to "small experiments" and a build from source, not a packaged offline or CI workflow. Neon Local appears only as a page title, and the claim flow provisions temporary cloud projects, so neither adds offline support. Missing for 10: a packaged local or Docker distribution of the engine, documented offline and CI test usage, explicit confirmation of no keys or cloud dependency, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the same engine locally and keylessly — no account or cloud dependency — for offline development and CI tests

citations.quote: Neon can be run on a workstation for small experiments and to test code changes
Alternatively, compile and run the project locally.
Neon is an open-source serverless Postgres database platform. It separates storage and compute
